Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About the Operations team
The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About the role
Affirm is seeking a people leader to drive scalable, compliant, and high-quality servicing experiences across our Operations organization. In this role, you will define and execute strategies that enable our servicing operations to scale efficiently while delivering exceptional outcomes for customers and merchants. You will set the vision for operational readiness, ensuring people, processes, and enablement systems evolve in alignment with Affirm’s servicing strategy across multiple domains and programs. 

As a manager within the Operations Enablement team, you will own team-level strategy and lead a high-performing team responsible for delivering a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives tied to strategic priorities. You will be accountable for execution across timelines and dependencies, with clear ownership of measurable business impact. 

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and vendor teams to ensure readiness for business and regulatory change. As a connective leader, you will translate strategy into action, driving adoption and outcomes through strong people leadership and disciplined delivery. We are looking for a hands-on, data-driven leader who thrives in complex, regulated environments and is passionate about building durable, high-quality servicing experiences at scale.

  • Own Program & Team Performance: Lead and manage a team responsible for delivering complex, cross-functional programs and initiatives, ensuring alignment with servicing strategy, OKRs, and long-term business priorities.

  • Partner for Impact: Collaborate closely with senior leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, and Operations to align priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.

  • Drive Stakeholder Engagement: Establish strong stakeholder engagement and governance practices, delivering clear, polished, and executive-ready communications on program status, outcomes, risks, and impact.

  • Manage Risk & Issue Resolution: Proactively identify risks, issues, and dependencies; propose data-backed solutions; and drive resolution in partnership with stakeholders.

  • Lead Operational Excellence: Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies to identify root causes, implement scalable improvements, and continuously raise the bar for quality, efficiency, and compliance.

  • Own Change End-to-End: Manage the full lifecycle of process and product changes—from design and implementation through change management, adoption, and measurement—ensuring meaningful impact for customers and the business.

  • Build Technical Resources: Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate technical concepts into clear manuals and resources for both human and AI agents.

jobs.title: AI Adoption & Enablement Consultant
jobs.description:
At AnswerRocket, we build transformative AI solutions that drive measurable results for Fortune 2000 Enterprises. For over a decade, we’ve helped industry leaders across sectors from consumer goods and construction to healthcare and financial services, harness AI to achieve tangible business outcomes. Our strength is the composition of our team: developers, data scientists, designers, architects, and AI/ML experts working alongside senior-level consultants. This combination allows us to solve enterprise AI challenges from strategy through implementation and optimization, and it is why some of the world’s largest companies seek us out.

We’re seeking an AI Adoption & Enablement Consultant to join our growing AI Adoption and AI Change Management practice. Reporting directly to the Practice Lead, you will lead client engagements from discovery through delivery, helping organizations turn AI investments into lasting capability and measurable business outcomes. You will also play a key role in shaping how the practice evolves, scales, and delivers impact for clients worldwide.

This is a fully remote role, supported by an Atlanta-based team, and requires occasional travel to client sites based on project needs.

The AI Adoption & AI Change Management Practice

Our practice helps organizations achieve meaningful, measurable adoption of AI. Our work spans clients deploying Claude across the enterprise, organizations building broader AI ecosystems, and companies seeking greater value from existing AI investments. We believe organizations do not struggle with AI because the technology falls short. They struggle because adoption is often treated as a software rollout rather than a transformation in how people work. Our practice exists to close that gap.

As an Anthropic partner and trusted advisor to enterprise clients worldwide, we combine AI enablement, business consulting, and change management to help organizations move beyond experimentation toward sustainable capability and measurable business outcomes.

The Opportunity

This is a highly client-facing consulting role that combines AI adoption, organizational change, business transformation, and practice development. You will help clients identify high-value AI opportunities, align initiatives to business objectives, and build adoption strategies that drive measurable outcomes, while helping refine the methodologies, frameworks, and offerings that support the practice’s continued growth.

Success in this role requires the ability to move comfortably between strategic consulting, stakeholder facilitation, executive communication, and hands-on delivery. You will work closely with client stakeholders, internal teams, and practice leadership to ensure organizations not only deploy AI tools, but successfully integrate them into the way work gets done.

Who You Are

Human-centered and business-minded. You understand that successful AI adoption begins with people, not technology, and you connect AI initiatives to business priorities, operational realities, and measurable outcomes.

Builder-oriented and adaptable. You thrive in environments where not every process is fully defined, bring structure to ambiguity, and are energized by helping shape a growing practice.

Collaborative and accountable. You influence stakeholders across business, technical, and executive audiences, drive progress without formal authority, and measure success through adoption, business impact, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

Enablement & Adoption Delivery

jobs.title: Renewals Strategy Principal Program Manager
jobs.description:
Role Description

Dropbox is entering an exciting new chapter in how we support, retain, and grow our customers.

As part of our evolving go-to-market strategy, Customer Experience & Success (CXS) will assume ownership of commercial renewals, creating a unique opportunity to rethink how we drive customer retention and long-term recurring revenue. We're looking for an experienced strategy and operations leader to help shape Dropbox's retention strategy, modernize our renewal operating model, and build the capabilities that enable customers to realize ongoing value from Dropbox.

As the Renewals Strategy Principal Program Manager, you'll lead the strategy, operating model, and execution behind this transformation. You'll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Product, Legal, and Engineering to develop retention strategies, design scalable programs, and build the playbooks, operating rhythms, and automation that enable Customer Success to successfully own a significant renewal business.

This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys designing scalable business capabilities, and is passionate about leveraging AI, automation, and data to improve customer retention and operational excellence. You'll identify new opportunities to reduce churn, increase customer engagement, simplify workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes while helping establish Customer Success as a world-class retention organization.

Over time, you'll help shape Dropbox's long-term customer lifecycle strategy, evolving our approach to customer retention across direct, channel, and self-serve motions.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Dropbox's retention strategy for commercial customers, identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes and recurring revenue.
  • Develop scalable retention programs, renewal strategies, and customer lifecycle initiatives that increase customer health, product adoption, and renewal rates.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Sales leadership to evolve the renewal operating model as Customer Success assumes ownership of commercial renewals.
  • Design playbooks, operating rhythms, and best practices that enable Customer Success to proactively identify and mitigate renewal risk.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to improve customer engagement, reduce manual work, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Product, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and Engineering to improve the end-to-end customer renewal experience.

jobs.description:

We are looking for a consultant who thrives at the intersection of process design, cross-functional coordination, and customer outcomes. As Asana transitions from Collaborative Work Management (CWM) to AI Workflow Management (AWM), you will lead enterprise customers through that same transformation — helping them define what AI-powered work looks like for their organization, aligning stakeholders around a shared adoption plan, and driving measurable impact across their highest-value workflows.

You will design and lead structured, time-bound engagements — from onboarding through workflow launch — that move customers from seeing Asana as just a work management platform, to a platform where teams and agents execute work together. This requires strong judgment, the ability to operate in ambiguity, and a consistent focus on connecting AI capabilities to business outcomes. You will regularly engage both executive stakeholders and front-line teams, adapting your approach to meet customers where they are and move them forward.

What You'll Do

You will lead customers through structured engagements in partnership with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions, and R&D to drive valuable adoption of AI.

Account Setup and Implementation Planning

  • Lead a structured onboarding engagement — aligning customer stakeholders on platform setup, workflow priorities, and a shared definition of success, while assessing workflow complexity to identify where AI capabilities will deliver the strongest early impact. 
  • Document and hand off a clear implementation plan — capturing recommended and prioritized workflows, known risks, and next steps so the activation phase can begin with full context and stakeholder alignment.

  • Lead end-to-end workflow design and build – guiding customers through deep discovery and process mapping, hands-on workflow configuration, and user acceptance testing to deliver production-ready workflows with AI capabilities embedded throughout.

Cross-Functional Responsibilities

  • Act as the connective tissue between delivery and growth - surface expansion signals during delivery, represent the voice of the customer internally, and partner with the account and R&D teams to translate customer momentum into growth.
  • Bring structure and repeatability to the delivery motion – define engagement processes, document decisions, and create repeatable frameworks that scale across a portfolio of customers to drive account momentum and program improvement.

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Implementation at Brex 

Implementation transforms new customers into power users. We lead the onboarding experience for companies adopting Brex Empower, helping them shift from outdated processes to a modern, employee-first approach. It’s a role that blends customer empathy, project management, technical expertise, process design, and change management. We take personal ownership of our customers' long-term success, and we set customers up thoroughly so they can be with ‘Brex for life’. As strategic advisors, we build trust, drive solutions with tenacity, deliver results fast, and work cross-functionally to make adoption seamless for customers.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Implementation Consultant, you will serve as a strategic advisor to our largest customers, guiding them through a successful launch of the Brex platform. Acting as a hybrid coach, project manager, and product expert, your primary goals will be to drive wide product adoption, deliver ongoing business value, and help customers transform their financial workflows.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

  • Act as a key cross-functional partner within the Brex account team, collaborating with Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships to deliver a smooth customer experience and align on partner-led solutions.
  • Influence product development by adapting quickly to product changes, communicating them strategically to stakeholders, and providing a key voice into future iterations of the product roadmap.
  • Build and execute a prioritization strategy for managing multiple high-touch customer relationships effectively.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About the Revenue team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About the Role

GTM Strategy & Operations takes product and pricing initiatives and creates commercially viable, operationally sound go-to-market motions. We partner with Product, Product Marketing, Legal, Rev Ops, and Pricing to design rollout groups, coordinate implementation, and equip the field — CSMs, AEs, and TAMs — with the processes they need to create world-class go-to-market. As an individual contributor, the Lead owns the go-to-market for a specific product line or segment end to end. You're handed the objective ("drive adoption for this new feature") and you decide how: the rollout plan, the enablement, the tracking. You turn half-formed product and pricing inputs into a plan a rep can actually execute.

What You'll Do

  • Own the go-to-market for a product line or segment end to end — rollout design, enablement, and the adoption target you're driving toward.

  • Turn inputs from cross-functional stakeholders like Product, Pricing, and PMM into a coherent GTM strategy, and track adoption against goal.

  • Fluently navigate different perspectives on the same launch — the exec "why it matters," the customer value proposition, and the rep's reasons to believe.

  • Build and maintain the materials, processes, and playbooks the field needs.

  • Sit close to the field, and turn what you hear into recommendations for Product Marketing.

  • Analyze performance data to find where a launch is stalling, and flag risks early.

What We Look For

  • 6+ years of experience in go-to-market strategy, product marketing, revenue or sales operations, ideally in FinTech, SaaS, or another high-growth environment.

  • A track record of owning a go-to-market motion or product line end to end, rollout through adoption, within a defined scope.

  • You've been handed vague "go make this work" instructions, then built a solution that resonated with stakeholders and customers.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, PMM, Client Success, Sales, Analytics, Legal, or Pricing.

  • Comfort translating product and pricing strategy into practical, field-ready execution.

  • Solid analytical instincts: you use adoption and performance data to decide what to do next, not just to report what happened.

  • Clear, action-oriented writing and speaking.

  • You do your best work in ambiguity and move fast without waiting to be told the approach.

  • Familiarity with merchant, payments, or fintech ecosystems is a must-have.

Pay Grade - K
Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $145,000 - $205,000

jobs.title: Associate Manager, New Verticals Strategy & Operations - Merchant Finance
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; United States - Remote
jobs.description:
About the Team

New Verticals is building DoorDash’s business beyond restaurants into categories like grocery, convenience, alcohol, and retail. Our Strategy & Operations team turns high-level goals around selection into clear plans and day-to-day execution for our merchants by partnering with product, finance, tax, operations, sales, and support. We focus on merchant experience, building sophisticated financial operating models and reliable reconciliation across New Verticals merchants in the US, while also considering the needs of global enterprise merchants.

About the Role

This role owns the core systems and processes that make sure Enterprise New Verticals merchants are billed, taxed, and paid accurately and consistently. You will sit at the intersection of product, finance, tax, and go-to-market teams to translate merchant needs into product requirements and operational workflows, and to make sure changes land cleanly for the field. In your first months, you will learn our current fee, tax, and payout structures, take over key recurring workflows, and then lead improvements that reduce issues and improve clarity for merchants and internal teams. Over time, you will shape how we launch and iterate on merchant-facing features that affect money flows in New Verticals.

You will report into the Senior Manager, Enterprise New Verticals on our New Verticals Onboarding & Excellence team in our Merchant Strategy and Operations organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead key workflows for merchant fees, billing, payouts, and tax application for U.S. Enterprise New Verticals merchants, with consideration for global enterprise merchants.
  • Own the Merchant Finance Product Roadmap, acting as the Product Operations partner and voice of the New Verticals merchant in product prioritization discussions related to invoicing, tax, and payouts.
  • Design and improve processes and products to triage and resolve payment, invoicing, and tax issues, including clear ownership, routing, and escalation paths.
  • Support product builds from idea to launch with business cases, success metrics, and rollout plans for merchant-facing changes.
  • Create and maintain clear internal documentation and communications so Partner Managers and downstream Accounting and Support teams can explain changes and handle questions from merchants.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 5-10 years of experience in strategy and operations, business operations, consulting, product operations, or similar analytical roles.
  • You are comfortable working with financial concepts like pricing, fees, discounts, taxes, and payouts, and partnering closely with finance and tax teams.
  • You can structure ambiguous merchant or payment problems, work across teams to find root causes, and drive a clear plan to fix them (or use AI to fix the issue yourself).
  • You can work with data (for example in spreadsheets or SQL) to size problems, build simple models, and track performance of your work.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and in meetings, and you can explain complex topics in simple, direct language to different audiences. 
  • You have experience leading and influencing multiple teams and senior leadership through complex, highly-cross-functional projects.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis.

jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

As the Manager, Growth Strategy & Operations for Square’s Global Account Management business, you will help design, execute, and scale the strategies and systems that deepen seller relationships, expand revenue, and maximize lifetime value across our global base of sellers. You'll focus on how Square grows with its existing customers, optimizing for retention, reducing churn, and driving expansion and multi-product adoption across regions, segments, and industries.

This is a builder's role at the intersection of growth strategy, revenue operations, and go-to-market engineering: you’ll pair traditional strategy work with book building, coverage models, KPI frameworks, and performance analysis with a strong bias toward automation and AI. A meaningful part of your impact will come from streamlining and automating the operational engine behind Account Management.

You'll partner closely with our Account Management, Data Science, Data Engineering, CRM, and Product/Eng teams on AM-focused tools and analysis to turn strategy into scalable, well-instrumented systems. Success looks like clearer strategy, faster and more reliable operations, and Account Managers who spend more time with sellers and less time on manual work.

This role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking, operational excellence, and executive influence. You will report to the Director of Growth Strategy & Operations, Global Account Management.

You Will

  • Growth and Retention Strategy

    • Help define and operationalize the Account Management strategy, with a primary focus on retention and churn reduction across segments and regions. This includes building and executing playbooks for key churn drivers.
    • Size opportunities and build the business cases that shape coverage models, book construction, and engagement plays for existing sellers.

    Revenue Operations & Performance Management

    • Build and maintain the operational cadence of the AM org: Book building and account assignment, pipeline hygiene, and rules of engagement.
    • Partner with Data Science and Finance to define KPIs and stand up dashboards and WBR/MBRs that run performance analysis and post-initiative impact reviews, translating complex data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations.

    Operational Automation & AI-Driven Experimentation

    • Streamline and automate the manual work that slows Account Management down: book building, Slack question triage, data enrichment, reporting, and routine workflows end to end.
    • Partner with CRM to build event-driven automations and AI agents across the GTM stack (e.g., Salesforce, Clay, and workflow tools).
    • Partner with Product/Eng to give Account Managers real-time visibility into seller health, churn risk, and expansion signals
    • Stay at the frontier of AI-native GTM tooling and bring proven new approaches into the team's playbook.

    Cross-Functional Execution & Program Management

    • Lead cross-functional workstreams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Customer Support, and Account Management, driving clarity, alignment, and momentum.
    • Translate business goals into clear technical requirements and documentation (e.g., PRDs / BRDs), and partner with technical teams to deliver end-to-end programs on time and to spec.
    • Break large, multi-quarter initiatives into pilots and future iteration

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. The Tax Operations and Delivery team protects user trust by enabling accurate, reliable, and scalable tax operations supporting the TaxJar and Stripe Tax products. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams to solve operational challenges, support new capabilities, and continuously improve how tax operations are delivered. 

 

As our products, partnerships, and operational footprint continue to grow, how we execute becomes just as important as what we execute. The Operations Program Management role exists to strengthen how Tax Operations and Delivery plans, coordinates, and delivers strategic work by building repeatable operating mechanisms that improve alignment, clarity, and execution across the team and its partners. If you’re energized by improving how teams work, bringing structure to ambiguity, and building scalable ways for teams to execute together, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of Tax Operations. 

What you’ll do

You’ll partner across Tax Operations, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to design and operationalize repeatable execution mechanisms that improve planning, coordination, and delivery for key initiatives. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys bringing structure to ambiguity, simplifying complex organizational challenges, and building practical solutions that improve how teams work together. Your impact will be measured by the repeatable mechanisms you build that make operational excellence easier to achieve across the team. 

Responsibilities

  • Design, maintain, and improve repeatable, lightweight execution mechanisms that track program status, communicate progress, surface execution risks on a regular cadence, and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.

  • Monitor initiatives through rollout, evaluate outcomes, and drive follow-up improvements or remediation where needed

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives from ambiguity to execution
  • Demonstrated ability to identify friction and design scalable improvements that drive measurable outcomes
  • Strong structured problem-solving and diagnostic thinking skills, with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and design scalable solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority
  • Experience designing or improving operational processes, governance, or execution mechanisms that increased organizational effectiveness

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience establishing operating rhythms, planning processes, or organizational governance
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS, fintech, or operationally complex environment
  • Familiarity with operational readiness, launch management, or change management practices

Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

 

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We are looking for someone who connects across data, financials and product & business strategy. and can unearth a signal in the noise and either fix the problem directly or convene the right people to fix it fast.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will work cross-functionally within our group and across Stripe’s technical and user-facing teams to solve problems and design workflows that benefit our users. Specifically:

  • Own the "Signal": You will define and maintain the metrics that actually matter for in-year performance. You’ll develop a "morning read" discipline—a curated, high-signal view of the business that drives immediate action,
    moving far beyond standard dashboarding.
  • Deep-Dive Interventions: You will lead "surge" projects to diagnose and unblock critical goals at risk. You aren't just identifying problems; you are staying in the arena until the trajectory has measurably changed.
  • Bridge Product & Strategy: You will translate long-horizon corporate theses into in-year operational reality. You’ll take ambiguous opportunities that cut across product, risk, and marketing and decompose them into structured
    workstreams.
  • Synthesize for Leadership: You’ll think ahead of our executive team, preparing CEO/COO-level materials that translate unstructured signals into structured diagnoses they can act on.
  • Pressure-test our Assumptions: You’ll work closely with Corporate Strategy and Product teams to identify gaps between our external market forces and our internal execution.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in product/data analytics within product organizations or strategic business performance teams at high-growth tech companies
  • Experience in Product Strategy, Product Management, or GM-style roles where you owned a P&L or a specific
    business outcome
  • Deeply curious about business models and data, probing into signals, understanding trends and customer usage patterns to uncover novel insights
  • A proven track record of directly driving business growth through analytical insights and execution
  • Apply AI to enhance decision-making and operational efficiency, know when and how to use the right AI tools to move faster without sacrificing rigor or quality
  • Strong product sense and the ability to understand the technical mechanics of how software products are built and scaled
  • Experience navigating ambiguous, cross-functional problems and leading high-stakes interventions with senior stakeholders
  • Prior experience with fintech products or complex financial systems is a plus, but not required
  • Experience facilitating senior leadership/ stakeholder meetings to drive meaningful conversations regarding Stripe’s business performance

Preferred qualifications

  • Payments ecosystem, or experience in finance or fintech is a plus
  • Ability to build trust and partner with senior leaders and CXOs
  • Technical proficiency in SQL / Python / R and d

jobs.title: Manager, Operations Program Management
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a highly motivated people manager for our Operations Program Manager (OPM) team with a strong background in New Product Introduction (NPI) within the hardware manufacturing space. In this critical role, you will be managing a team of OPMs to ensure the successful operational launch of our cutting-edge products, from development through mass production and sustained volume. You will orchestrate complex cross-functional efforts, manage risks, and drive decisions that impact product cost, quality, and time to market.

This is a remote position based in the US. This position requires travel up to 20% of the time. 

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead a global Operations Program Management team based in North America and Asia to develop and launch new hardware products.
  • Own end-to-end operational execution of hardware product manufacturing from concept through mass production and sustained volume.
  • Serve as the primary operations liaison, aligning and communicating across Engineering, Product, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Develop comprehensive program plans, manage schedules, budgets, and proactively mitigate risks to ensure on-time and on-cost delivery.
  • Define and execute manufacturing strategies, collaborating with internal teams and external partners for factory readiness, capacity, and process development.
  • Drive cost reduction initiatives and ensure robust quality standards are met throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing preferred), Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field. A master's degree (MBA or MS) is a plus.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Operations Program Management, NPI, or related roles within a hardware manufacturing environment.
  • Minimum 3 years managing a team of at least 4 individuals.
  • Proven track record of successfully launching multiple complex hardware products from concept to high-volume production and strong understanding of hardware development lifecycles and manufacturing processes.

jobs.description: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. ABOUT THE ROLE Ramp’s Franchise Channel is seeing rapid growth, and as an early member of the team, you’ll have the opportunity to help scale the go-to-market engine and strategy that fuels a key growth driver for the company. At Ramp, we are looking for candidates with a proven track record of acquiring and building net new relationships with corporate and franchise partners, enabling and onboarding their businesses, and achieving consistent quota attainment and overachievement through strategic relationship development. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Source, qualify and conduct deep discovery with net new Franchise partners - Sign partners and create comprehensive GTM plans - Drive revenue for Ramp through generating referrals from franchisors and franchisees - Identify and build relationships with multiple stakeholders within an organization - Educate partners on Ramp’s offering and articulate the value props - Hold monthly and quarterly business reviews with key partners - Work cross-functionally across marketing, growth, direct sales, and product & engineering to drive co-marketing opportunities, onboard new clients and inform our product roadmap - Become an expert in Ramp’s product, features, and workflows - Build new (and improve existing) workflows and sales motions to contribute to our team’s continued success WHAT YOU NEED - Minimum 7 years of work experience with a minimum 3 years of experience in Partner Sales, Business Development, Partnership Management, or Channel Partnerships - Strong discovery skills, with a knack for identifying pain points and consultative selling - History as a top performer, regularly exceeding targets and quotas - Dedication to tracking and improving performance and efficiency on a daily basis - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with excellent listening skills - Bias for action and strong desire to work in a fast-paced startup environment - Strong cross-functional collaborator who can build relationships across the company - Experience with and affinity for AI tooling that empowers your work NICE-TO-HAVES - Prior experience partnering with both franchisors and franchisees in a consulting, sales, or partnerships capacity BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL) - Flexible PTO - Centralized home-office equipment ordering - Health and wellness stipend - Budget for intra-office travel - Weekly coffee stipend UNITED STATES - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents - One Medical annual membership - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay - Pet insurance - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) CANADA - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP) - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health UNITED KINGDOM - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. OTHER NOTICES Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our Advertising & Promotions team operates at the intersection of e-commerce and advertising, surfacing and monetizing relevant content that benefits our core audiences.  We provide digital solutions to help advertisers reach DoorDash audiences.

The Agency & Partnerships Strategy & Operations team partners closely with our Sales organization to grow the agency holding company channel — Publicis, WPP, Dentsu, Omnicom, and more — into a scaled, durable revenue stream, and to build and scale the strategic partnerships (data, measurement, verification, and technology) that support DoorDash’s broader advertising platform.

About the Role

We’re looking for a strategic operator to own the day-to-day strategy and operations for DoorDash’s Agency Sales channel. As the Senior Manager, Agency Partnerships Strategy & Operations, you will drive the JBP process, revenue reporting, and operating rhythm that turn our relationships with agency holding companies — Publicis, WPP, Dentsu, and more — into durable, incremental revenue, while partnering closely with Sales, Product, Finance, and Legal to unlock new growth.

Specifically, you will:

Airbnb is redefining the world's approach to accommodation and travel. We are creating highly local, personal and authentic experiences for our host and guest community around the world. jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner. 

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. 

This role is a remote position open to candidates residing in Germany. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

Will require travel to customer sites in Germany, The Netherlands and the United Kingdom, for up to 20% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether a customer achieves their sustainability goals, or whether power gets restored quickly after an incident
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform 
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value 
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals 
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

  • Manage customer and regulatory-sensitive escalations through root-cause analysis and remediation, and report CX quality and compliance KPIs to senior stakeholders with trend analysis and improvement recommendations.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant I, Commercial
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Implementation at Brex

Implementation transforms new customers into power users. We lead the onboarding experience for companies adopting Brex Empower, helping them shift from outdated processes to a modern, employee-first approach. It’s a role that blends customer empathy, project management, technical expertise, process design, and change management. We take personal ownership of our customers' long-term success, and we set customers up thoroughly so they can be with ‘Brex for life’. As strategic advisors, we build trust, drive solutions with tenacity, deliver results fast, and work cross-functionally to make adoption seamless for customers.

What you’ll do

The Implementation Consultant I role on the Commercial team supports our small to mid-sized customers through their onboarding journey, helping them get up and running on Brex with guidance and structured support. As an initiator on the team, you’ll develop your product knowledge, sharpen your project management skills, and build the foundation for a career in implementation consulting.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate customer meetings by managing agendas, capturing notes, tracking action items, and setting clear expectations throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Support customers in understanding their business needs and configuring Brex to address them, translating basic requirements into product configurations with guidance.
  • Manage straightforward stakeholder communication and assist with timelines and deliverables to keep implementations on track.
  • Assist with spend migrations and support end user adoption during deployment, helping customers feel confident and prepared for go-live.
  • Introduce integration concepts to customers, provide relevant guides for connecting Brex with external systems, and engage Technical Consultants for more complex integration or troubleshooting needs.
  • Coordinate handoffs between AE/CSE and CSM, providing basic documentation to ensure continuity of the client relationship.
  • Deliver standard change management templates to customers in preparation for go-live, and lead training sessions with supervision as needed.
  • Collaborate within the Implementation team and contribute feedback on the client experience when asked, supporting process improvements over time.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within a SaaS organization or a consulting firm that delivers SaaS services.
  • Some exposure to project coordination or structured implementation work.
  • Strong communication skills, both with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Comfort working across technical and non-technical workstreams with guidance.
  • Organized and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of urgency in driving tasks to completion.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally to resolve issues.

Bonus points

  • Experience in Financial, Expense Management, or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with any of the following domains: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Expense Management, Travel, Procurement, or Corporate Card programs.

Implementation at Brex

Implementation transforms new customers into power users. We take personal ownership of our customers' long-term success, and we set customers up thoroughly so they can be with ‘Brex for life’. As strategic advisors, we build trust, drive solutions with tenacity, deliver results fast, and work cross-functionally to make adoption seamless for customers.

What you’ll do

The Implementation Consultant I role on the Commercial team supports our small to mid-sized customers through their onboarding journey, helping them get up and running on Brex with guidance and structured support. Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Responsibilities

The Solutions Consulting Team at Remote acts as a strategic partner to both customers and internal teams, building trust and reinforcing confidence in the Remote partnership. This global team brings expertise in HR strategy across Remote’s full suite of products and services, with a focus on enhancing customer engagement and driving commercial success.

As a Global Payroll Solutions Consultant, you will play a key role in the successful launch and long-term expansion of Remote’s Global Payroll offering, shaping go-to-market efforts and helping to deliver lasting value to our clients.

  • Writes and speaks fluent English.

Remote (US) or New York, New York, USA

You'll support both internal teams and external partners by providing guidance on pricing models, deal structures, incentives, and commercial programs. This role reports to the Manager, Global Partner Programs, Channels & Alliances.

jobs.title: GTM AI Revenue Enablement, Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

GTM Enablement at Brex

Brex's go-to-market org is forward thinking with out AI tooling and support across Sales, RevOps, and Enablement. While we’ve made a promising start, our AI applications have been built ad hoc, with no shared standards, no central ownership, and no consistent way to measure whether they actually move the number. This is a highly impactful, net-new role for Brex: the first person on Revenue Enablement accountable for turning "a bunch of AI experiments" into a governed, prioritized, production-grade AI capability for the entire GTM org.

This isn't a prompt-engineering or tooling-rollout role. It's a hybrid of strategist, engineer, and embedded partner - someone who can set the roadmap for GTM AI investment, personally build and ship the applications that matter most, and then get in the trenches with sellers to make sure the work actually gets adopted. This person will serve as a lynchpin between Sales, Revenue operations, product and engineering. 

What you'll do

This role lives inside GTM Enablement, so your charter is the systems that make sellers effective including how they get certified, how they get ramped, how they get collateral, and how they get better at their craft. AI is the mechanism; enablement is the domain. Some of what you’ll work on:

  • Set the internal sales enablement AI roadmap. Own the prioritization framework for how Brex builds AI applications and tooling across the enablement lifecycle including certification, onboarding, content, coaching, ramp. Decide what gets built next, what gets sunset, and why.
  • Build and standardize GTM’s AI tooling stack. Write, review, and ship code yourself. You're not handing specs to an engineering team — you are a capable coder with a strong product sense who  develops AI tooling for GTM reps. 
  • Make the build-vs-buy call. Continuously evaluate what enablement capability Brex should leverage third-party vendors (Gong, Itero, Highspot-type tools) for particular use-cases versus build in-house on Brex's own AI stack (Claude, etc.). This is a real strategic judgment call, not a default toward either — you'll need a clear framework for when a point solution is worth buying and when it's worth owning.
  • Go deep on the sales domain. Understand the sales process — pipeline stages, seller CRM workflows, quota mechanics, what "good" looks like on a call — well enough to know where AI creates real leverage in enablement versus where it's a solution looking for a problem.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in one of our 5 hubs (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Salt Lake City and Vancouver). We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Requirements

  • 4+ years in a role that combined hands go-to-market (Revenue ops or Enablement) with 1+ year focused on building sales-technology domain work
  • Proven ability to ship production code — not prototypes or internal scripts, but tools that sales teams rely on daily (Python/TypeScript or comparable; LLM/agentic application experience strongly preferred)
  • Real fluency in sales process and domain knowledge — you can sit in a pipeline review or forecast call and understand what's actually happening
  • A track record of defining and tracking success metrics for your own initiatives — you don't wait for someone else to tell you if it worked</

gaps: Outside the remote-US or DFW-hybrid target

jobs.title: Retail Sales Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

As a Retail Sales Enablement Manager, you'll partner closely with your enablement peers and cross-functional partners to build and deliver enablement programs that set new hires up to succeed and equip Retail Account Executives with the ongoing training and resources they need to sharpen their sales process and stay a step ahead in an evolving retail industry and competitive landscape.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Create, schedule, deliver, and sustain technical and sales enablement programs that accelerate new hire and ramping AE readiness on sales process, competitive positioning, and retail-segment use cases.
  • Design and facilitate engaging training experiences, including classroom-style sessions, certifications, role-plays, mock pitches, on-demand learning (Workramp LMS), and occasional onsite events.
  • Develop and maintain enablement content such as playbooks, cheat sheets, battle cards, frameworks, and sales tool resources.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure training programs align with product roadmap, go-to-market priorities, and sales leadership goals.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, sales-ready messaging that improves AE effectiveness in customer conversations.
  • Reinforce best practices for sales tools (CRM, demo environments, automation platforms) to maximize AE efficiency.
  • Support sales leadership in driving performance metrics, ensuring new hire cohorts achieve ramp milestones, sales targets, and OKRs.
  • Maintain and evolve enablement resources, recurring programs, and training materials to ensure ongoing effectiveness and scalability.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 2+ years of direct sales experience with a track record of high performance; prior enablement, training, or marketing experience a plus
  • Proven ability to coach, mentor, and provide actionable feedback to sales professionals
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies (e.g., Sandler, SPIN, Challenger, MEDDPICC) and demonstrated success in driving adoption
  • Strong project management skills with experience creating enablement or training materials
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to command an audience and influence outcomes
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze performance metrics and identify strengths and areas for improvement in sellers
  • Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and execution abilities
  • Ability to work independently, manage distributed teams, and pivot quickly in a fast-changing environment
  • Systems/Tools proficiency: Salesforce (or similar CRM), Google Sheets, conversational intelligence platforms, and email engagement tools
  • Willingness to travel occasionally (roughly 4x/year)

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

The Platform Partnerships team at Block drives business development and commercialization efforts for Square payments, Afterpay and Cash App Pay. This specialized team sources and develops strategic partners including software platforms, ERPs and ISVs that integrate with Square’s Payments APIs, with the aim to extend the reach of Square’s payments and products across the software and technology ecosystem, and enable Enterprise Sellers. Success is measured by GPV growth, Seller referrals, Enterprise wins and mutual growth. We are looking for an experienced partnerships practitioner with deep expertise in payments, business development and partner management to join our team.

The ideal candidate has experience sourcing and managing strategic partnerships, strong commercial acumen, a solid understanding of the payments industry, and a passion for small businesses. You understand API capabilities and technical integrations, and you know how to translate partner opportunity into a robust go-to-market plan that drives measurable results. You build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders internally and externally, and adapt quickly as Square’s ecosystem and the competitive landscape evolve.

 

You will:

  • Lead enterprise payment partnerships: Own a portfolio of high-value, payments-integrated partners end to end, serving as their primary contact at Square. 
  • Drive go-to-market execution: Collaborate closely with partners and Square’s Sales and Account Management teams to build and execute growth plans with new and existing Sellers.
  • Build API expertise: Develop deep knowledge of Square’s APIs and partnership models so you can speak credibly with prospective and current partners about integration options and Square’s platform strategy.
  • Source and sign partners: Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and close new partnership agreements with software platforms that can drive meaningful growth for Square.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner closely with Product, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Account Management and Legal.
  • Own business results: Track pipeline, launch progress, partner performance, and growth initiatives tied to GPV, seller acquisition, and other key business outcomes.

Qualifications:

  • 8 years of overall work experience, including 6+ years in partnerships, business development, or a related field. 
  • Experience building and growing partnerships, integrations, or go-to-market programs that delivered measurable business impact.
  • Track record of sourcing, negotiating, and closing a high volume of strategic partnerships.
  • Strong understanding of the payments industry is preferred.
  • Familiarity with APIs and technical integrations preferred; comfortable working with Product and Solutions Engineering teams to scope partner requirements and evaluate integration paths.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple partner relationships, commercial workstreams, and competing priorities at once.

jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash for Business is building the premier corporate dining and benefits platform—helping companies of all sizes feed their teams through industry-leading products and meal programs. Our mission is to become the go-to solution for executives, administrators, and employees who need seamless, high-quality food programs at work. We move fast, operate with an ownership mindset, and are growing new product lines to better serve our corporate customers.

About the Role

As a Senior Associate on the DoorDash for Business Catering team, you will own the Dasher and delivery experience for catering—making sure large, high-stakes catering orders show up on time, get handed off and set up correctly, and reach the customer the way they expect. 

You'll work at the intersection of operations, logistics, and analytics—getting deep into the details of how catering deliveries actually play out on the ground, forming hypotheses about what's breaking, and running small, fast tests to find what works before we scale it. This is early-stage, hands-on problem solving, not optimizing a machine that already runs.

You will report into the Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations for DoorDash for Business and can work remotely or hybrid depending preference. 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own Dasher quality for catering: Take end-to-end ownership of delivery quality for catering—on-time arrival, accurate drop-off and setup, and a clean handoff—so customers can trust every order.
  • Find the right logistics model: Figure out how catering deliveries should actually work—Dasher selection, batching, timing, equipment, and handoff—by testing different approaches and learning what holds up in the real world.
  • Get into the details: Dig into individual deliveries, talk to Dashers and customers, and trace exactly where things break down—then turn those root causes into concrete operational fixes.
  • Use AI to optimize how we operate: Build the automated workflows that show where catering deliveries break down—and lean on AI to turn slow, manual analysis and one-off fixes into repeatable processes the team can scale.
  • Influence the Product Roadmap: Translate what you learn on the ground into clear product and operational recommendations that make catering delivery more reliable.

We're excited about you because…

  • You have 3–5 years of experience in strategy & operations, logistics, management consulting, or a high-growth marketplace environment.
  • You have a track record of owning operational problems end-to-end—from diagnosis to testing to rollout—and are comfortable building from scratch in ambiguous, early-stage environments.
  • You're analytically strong: you write SQL, work fluently with data, and know how to get to the root cause and turn complexity into clear recommendations.
  • You demonstrate fluency with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar) to automate workflows, surface insights, and drive faster, better decisions.
  • You communicate with clarity and influence—you can tailor your message for Dashers, operators, cross-functional partners, and senior leadership alike.
  • You love getting into the weeds—you'll happily roll up your sleeves, get to the lowest level of detail, and run the test yourself to find out what works.

Own and Govern the Engineering Knowledge Base

jobs.title: Program Manager, Security GRC
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Stripe Security team is dedicated to improving the security of Stripe and its users. Our users trust us with some of their most sensitive information, and we make security a first-class consideration in everything we do. Security concerns are ever-evolving, creating an extremely dynamic environment for the Security team.

The Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SGRC) team at Stripe provides security governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities to allow Stripe to make strategic security decisions, measure our risk and control posture, and represent Stripe Security to internal and external entities. The successful operation of our organization accelerates Stripe by optimizing the communication and expectations of our security program.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Security GRC Program Manager with deep expertise in security compliance to serve as the primary interface between Stripe's Security organization and external auditors, regulators, and compliance stakeholders. In this role, you'll represent the Security team in audit engagements, articulate how Stripe's security controls are designed and how they operate, and ensure that compliance obligations across a complex global regulatory landscape are met with consistency and rigor.

In this role, you will act as a proxy between external entities like regulators and auditors, and our internal security teams, ensuring consistency in compliance responses and helping maintain a lean and effective compliance program. The ideal candidate is adaptable and finds structure in an evolving and maturing organization.

Responsibilities

  • Act as an information security subject matter expert during cross-functional audit engagements, representing the Security team in walkthrough meetings with auditors and regulators
  • Serve as the internal liaison (proxy) between  and the Security organization to ensure audits are managed effectively and consistently
  • Create and maintain a central repository of audit evidence artifacts required for compliance with SOC 2, PCI DSS, SOX, and other global regulatory standards
  • Perform security risk and control assessments against common frameworks to ensure compliance with Stripe's Information Security Policy and Standards and applicable regulations (e.g., ISO 2700x, PCI DSS, SOX, NIST, COBIT)
  • Support control owners with guidance on security control design and redesign to ensure continued compliance and effectiveness
  • Facilitate security compliance support for Stripe's legal entities with regulatory obligations, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to track and report on control remediation efforts
  • Support broader GRC team program initiatives, including policy writing, security awareness training, and third-party security risk assessments

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Subject matter expert in information security frameworks, practices, policies, standards, and procedures (e.g., NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/2, or equivalent)
  • 6+ years of experience in Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance or Technology Compliance roles with a strong understanding of audit processes
  • Exposure to global regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA, FFIEC, EBA, NYDFS) and experience integrating them into compliance programs
  • Experience conducting security audits and supporting compliance across complex, overlapping regulatory frameworks
  • Strong program management skills with proficiency in coordinating security assessments and managing multiple stakeholder engagements across time zones
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels and translate technical security concepts for auditors, regulators, and executive audiences

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

About the Role

We are looking for a Principal Supply Chain Partner Manager to join the Instacart Business & Supply Chain team. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates at the intersection of strategy, enterprise partnership, and cross-functional leadership. You will own Instacart's most complex and highest-impact supply chain relationships, setting the strategic direction for how we engage with and grow our largest distributors and network partners.

Beyond managing a portfolio of partners, you will shape how the broader team operates — establishing playbooks, influencing product direction, and serving as a thought leader internally and externally. You will be a trusted advisor to C-suite stakeholders on the partner side and a key voice in executive conversations internally. This role requires someone who can navigate deep ambiguity, build consensus across competing priorities, and drive outcomes that are felt at the company level.

This team's innovative strategies and dynamic industry relationships directly contribute to shaping our market presence and commercial success.

About You

Minimum Qualifications
